params.body:
Follows #78. The title of the video block went out in capitals, in the register of the small collection labels; every other h2 on the site is set in the rich-text register (27px, regular weight, no capitals), and the title sat 20px above the player.

## What changed

- The title takes the site's section-heading register: 27px, weight 400, letter-spacing 1px, no transform (24px on a phone).
- 32px between the title and the player (24px on a phone); the optional line of text keeps the same distance.

## Verification

Checked on the live home with the stylesheet applied over it, at 1280px and 390px. Pint, PHPStan and the suite pass; `BuildStampTest`, `EnvCheckTest` and `BestelpadControleTest` fail in a git worktree only (no `.env`, no checkout ref) and pass in CI.
params.title: Set the video title in the section-heading register, with room above the player
